methods.blocks: 10-s blocks of the raw 1 kHz torque, from t=0 (9 blocks; the last 0.1 s is dropped); mean and SD with ddof=1
methods.hold_0_20s: mean / SD (ddof=1) of the raw torque over the first 20 s
methods.traces_100Hz: dataset_builder.downsample_trial(factor=10): scipy.signal.decimate(ftype='fir', zero_phase=True); whole passive trial, no 1 s trim; t = index/100 s from the first sample; 9010 samples for the 90.1 s trial

a_jm.note: file_trial = trial_index + 1 (storyboard '#21' = trial_index 20 = 'passive at p7, test'). Static table has no entry near -0.07 (the p7 passive trial is rejected as a whole: SD 14.6 Nm), so the static rule gives the value interpolated between the neighbouring table entries; the first 20 s of that trial (a real hold) is not used by either rule because the device never steps in this trial, so it is not cut into pieces.
table_entry_notes: S1 table entry near -0.07 = running mean of 2 accepted pieces: file trial 21 piece starting at sample 0; file trial 15 piece starting at sample 21100
S2 table entry near -0.07 = running mean of 1 accepted piece(s): file trial 31 piece starting at sample 21100
the p7 passive trial of S2 (file trial 37) is REJECTED by the legacy |mean| <= 20 Nm test (mean +20.98 Nm, SD 15.98 Nm)

audit_item2_check.note: table mean minus mean of the in-trial EMG-rest baseline B (truth cache), toes-down cells (2 most negative angles) of CH, EG, HM, JM, YES in both sessions = 20 trials; audit 00_audit.md section 6 item 2 says 'too high in 20 of 20, by 0.6-2 Nm'.

b_static_hold_sd.note: sd = numpy std (ddof=0), the quantity tested by the static rule (<= 1.0 Nm). 'static_map_pieces' = pieces of passive-classified trials accepted by the rule (these build the static tables); 'framework_holds' = the framework's hold list (every non-active, non-MVC trial, so YES's mis-labelled trials are included). subject index into SUBJ = CH, EG, HM, IES, JM, YES; session 1/2.

c_yes_m049.note: relaxed level = median torque over EMG-detected rest stretches inside the active trial (truth.session_rest, EMG only); B(t) = smooth baseline through them (truth.baseline). The worksheet value is what the baseline subtracts; the recorded hold is the separate trial that preceded the active trial at the same angle.

definitions.share_squared_error: mse x n of each position's fit windows / total, from final_per_trial['fit'] at the kept (restored) epoch of the seed-0 X00f run = the share of the fit-set squared error (what the optimiser minimised)
definitions.share_sum_squares_about_zero: sum of y^2 per position / total: the loss of a network that predicted 0 everywhere
definitions.share_target_variation_within_position: sum of squared deviations of the fit targets from each POSITION's own mean / total; = what is left to explain once the per-position level is known (the quantity R2 is built on)
definitions.share_variation_about_global_mean: deviations from the fit set's overall mean (within + between positions)
definitions.targets: fit targets = measured - legacy session-1 table (X00f passive='legacy'), first 80 % of each session-1 trial, rebuilt with splits.build; trial list, n and angle checked against the json
definitions.toes_down_two: the two most negative angles of the person
